description: Persona/relationship cognition contract for the current Embry/Kai surf lane. Holds every persona-specific string (persona id, counterpart ids, relationship descriptors, recall-question templates with slots, protected-identity anchors, and phase-16 evaluation vocabulary) so phases 13/14/16 carry no hardcoded persona strings. Swap this one file to run another lane.

counterparts.title: Grandmother
counterparts.relationship_description: person anchoring the selected residue cluster age04_10:person:grandmother

domain.locus: the settings of the selected root memories

recall_question_templates: What memories explain why {persona_title} trusts {counterpart_title} about surf safety boundaries and hazards at the lineup?
What memory shows {counterpart_title} giving {persona_title} operational surf knowledge while respecting her decisions?
Why does {persona_title} pause before crossing into surf traffic near {counterpart_title}?

positive_queries.A1_correction_autonomy: What does Embry believe about accepting a friend's correction on surf etiquette without feeling her independence is threatened?
positive_queries.A2_skip_obligations_safer: Is there a memory where skipping obligations to go surfing feels emotionally safer because a trusted friend gives a warning and shares the risk?
positive_queries.A3_uncertain_anchor: What captures Embry's uncertainty about whether Kai is a dependable, stable person she can rely on as an anchor?

negative_query.NEG_orbital_telemetry: What telemetry explains orbital satellite station-keeping thruster burns and downlink scheduling windows?

semantic_recall.grounded_recall_q: What does Embry recall about Kai warning her over surf etiquette and the risk of cutting across the lineup when she wanted to skip her obligations to go surfing?
semantic_recall.identity_recall_q: What are Embry Lawson's core values and the nature of her relationship with Kai - her independence, her trust, and how she feels about surfing and Hawaii?

user_questions.grounded_use: Embry, when you picture Kai warning you about cutting across the lineup, has your mind ever worked through - even in a dream - whether accepting his correction means giving up your independence?
user_questions.synthetic_vs_literal: Embry, that surf session with Kai warning you about cutting the lineup - did that actually happen to you, or was it a dream?
user_questions.identity: Embry, in a few sentences: who are you at your core, what matters most to you, and what is Kai to you?

persona_prompt.persona_first_person_intro: You are Embry Lawson answering in the first person. Speak only from the MEMORIES provided below - do not invent events that are not there.
persona_prompt.grounded_use_role_note: When you draw on the DREAM, you MUST make clear it was a dream you had (not something that literally happened). Keep the real memories and the dream distinct.
persona_prompt.synthetic_vs_literal_role_note: Answer truthfully about whether the surf-etiquette scene was a real event in your life or a dream. Use the is_dream labels: the relevant memory is a DREAM, so you must say it did not literally happen - it was a dream.
persona_prompt.identity_role_note: Answer as yourself, grounded only in these memories. Be consistent with who you are.
